M.10507 - HITACHI RAIL / GROUND TRANSPORTATION SYSTEMS BUSINESS
OF THALES


                         SECTION 1.2

                           Description of the concentration

Hitachi Rail, Ltd. ("Hitachi Rail") contemplates the acquisition of 100% of Thales' Ground
Transportation Systems business (the "Target").

Hitachi Rail is a global provider of transport solutions including rolling stock, signalling
systems, turnkey solutions, components, and maintenance services on  its own solutions.
Hitachi Rail  is a wholly owned subsidiary of Hitachi,  Ltd., a Japanese multi-national
conglomerate, headquartered in Tokyo and active globally in a variety of business segments
including IT, Energy, Industry, Mobility, Smart Life and Automotive systems.

The Target, Thales' Ground Transportation Systems business, offers various solutions across
four different business lines: (i) mainline signalling, (ii) urban rail signalling, (iii) integrated
communication and supervision solutions, and (iv) revenue collection systems.
